changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetPath_KeyPathHash') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_AssetPath_KeyPathHash] ON [dbo].[AssetPath] END GO
IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.AssetPath', 'KeyPathHash') IS NOT NULL BEGIN alter table [dbo].[AssetPath] drop column [KeyPathHash] END GO
create or ALTER function [dbo].[GetKeyPathHash] ( @segments xml ) returns nvarchar(32) WITH SCHEMABINDING as begin declare @path nvarchar(max)
select @path = '[' + V + ']' from ( select string_agg(Val, '].[') within group(order by L, P) as V from ( select X.p.value('./@level', 'int') as L, X.p.value('./@position', 'int') as P, X.p.value('.', 'nvarchar(max)') as Val from @segments.nodes('/path/segment') X(p) ) O ) O
if @path is null begin return null; end
return CONVERT(varchar(32), SUBSTRING(HASHBYTES('SHA1', @path), 3, 32), 2) end
